result.brief: 提出资源受限的离线系统，将文本/图像/单目视频转为版本化点表示，联合更新相机、点与轨迹，并用多假设自适应表面链接（MHAC）提升长程跟踪覆盖。
result.reason: Offline system combining video generation, dynamic 4D reconstruction and monocular SLAM with adaptive surface association; contributes 4D scene construction and tracking, not a representation or world-model learning contribution.
